description: Activate when: user says 'seven questions,' 'Zero to One test,' 'Thiel checklist,' 'should I start this business,' 'is this startup idea any good,' or 'stress-test my startup idea'; a business idea, pivot, product line, or funding decision is about to proceed on enthusiasm rather than evidence; a pitch or plan is strong on one dimension (usually technology or market size) and silent on the others; the user wants a structured go/no-go gate before committing capital, time, or reputation to a venture. Do NOT activate when: the venture is already running and the question is a single-dimension diagnosis (pricing, one channel, one hire) — use the specific skill for that dimension instead; the decision is a small reversible experiment where a full seven-question gate is heavier than the bet itself; the user asked only to polish pitch wording, not to test whether the underlying business should exist. More: deciqai.com/c/seven-questions-test
